translations.web: There you shall build an altar to Yahweh your God, an altar of stones. You shall not use any iron tool on them.
translations.bsb: Moreover, you are to build there an altar to the LORD your God, an altar of stones. You must not use any iron tool on them.
translations.kjv: And there shalt thou build an altar unto the LORD thy God, an altar of stones: thou shalt not lift up any iron
translations.asv: And there shalt thou build an altar unto Jehovah thy God, an altar of stones: thou shalt lift up no iron tool upon them.
